reviews.text: Good but Has Room to Improve. The app is easy to use and does a decent job identifying plants. While it works for basic needs, adding more detailed information and improving accuracy would make the experience much better.
7.99 biweekly charge. They have been slipping away with double and triple charging my account through PayPal.
Cancel my subscription. I don’t want this
Great at identifying!!. Tried several apps- this one was absolutely the best at identifying any plant I took a pic of versus several other apps!!

7.99 a week!. The good: I have just started native gardening and converting my property to be wildlife friendly. This app accurately identified so many wildflowers, shrubs, trees that are growing on my property to let me differentiate between invasive and natives. The bad: $7.99 a week is way too much for me. I appreciate how good the app is and that the cost needs to reflect that, but dishing out $32 a month is not do-able. The really bad: I cancelled it and all of my saved plants are gone. I think that we should at least be able to keep our saved plants without a paid account. And maybe have different levels of memberships?

Best all in one plant care app. I’ve been using this plant care app for a few weeks and it’s made a big difference in how I take care of my plants. 

The Plant ID feature is super accurate, and I love the personalized care tips. It even reminds me when to water and fertilize. The interface is clean and easy to use. And the disease diagnosis tool helped me save my fiddle leaf fig. 

Highly recommend for anyone who wants happier healthier plants!
